version.promotional_text: Spot the fork. Find the mate. Survive the streak. 53,000 puzzles from real games that get harder as you get better. Pawn today, King someday.
version.description:
Think you can see three moves ahead? Prove it.

King Walk throws real chess puzzles at you, 53,000 of them, pulled from actual games. Solve one and the next gets tougher. Miss one and it backs off. A few dozen puzzles in, it knows exactly how good you are. Then it starts pushing.

You start as a Pawn. Earn Knight, Bishop, Rook and Queen. Reach King and you've walked the whole board.

• 53,000 puzzles from real games: forks, pins, skewers and sneaky back-rank mates
• A rating that finds your level and climbs with you
• A daily puzzle, the same for everyone. Keep the streak alive, brag in emoji
• Rank streaks: 15 puzzles, no hints, one miss and you're out
• Challenge friends in Game Center and settle who's actually good
• Stuck? Take a hint. We won't tell anyone.
• Missed one? It comes back later for a rematch
• Big, loud celebrations every time you rank up
• Widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy
• A daily reminder, if you want one
• Haptics, dark mode, VoiceOver and larger text
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases

The puzzles come from the public-domain Lichess puzzle database. King Walk is not made or endorsed by Lichess.

review_notes:
King Walk is a single-player chess puzzle game. No account, no login, no in-app purchases, no ads, no user-generated content, no chat.

A video of the app in use is attached (App Review Information > Attachment).

PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
For anyone who wants to get better at chess tactics, from beginners to club players. Each puzzle is a position from a real game where there is one best line. The player's puzzle rating goes up with clean solves and down with misses, and the next puzzles are chosen near that rating, so the difficulty follows the player.

HOW TO USE IT (no setup needed)
- Launch the app. The first puzzle loads right away: the other side moves first, then it is your turn ("White to play", with the goal, e.g. "Checkmate in 2").
- Tap a piece, then tap where it goes (or drag it). A wrong move is shown and taken back.
- Hint makes the piece to move glow; a second hint draws an arrow to where it goes. Answer plays the solution.
- After each puzzle: Next puzzle. The Progress card shows the rating, rank ladder, stats and a rating chart.
- Daily puzzle (the calendar button at the top; the puzzle-piece button beside it goes back to regular puzzles): one a day, the same for everyone, picked from the date with no server. Solving it on consecutive days builds a daily streak, and every 7 days in a row earns a streak freeze that covers a missed day. Afterwards a card shows the result with Share (a row of coloured squares and the time, no moves) and Close; the solved board then offers Try again (practice, which doesn't change the result) and Back to puzzles.
- Rank streaks (under Progress, tap Rank streaks to open them): tap a rank for 15 puzzles that climb through it, with Hint and Answer off; a wrong move ends the run. They don't change the rating and are the Game Center challenges.
- Settings (the gear, top right): Sound, Left-handed layout, Haptics, Daily reminder (off unless the player picks a time; a local notification), puzzle difficulty, Share, Game Center (leaderboards and achievements), Start over, How it works, Credits, Advanced (Copy save code and Paste save code, to move progress to the website), and Support / Privacy / Terms / Press kit links.
- Widgets: rank, and the daily puzzle (also StandBy). Control Center control and Siri / Shortcuts action "Play today's puzzle"; long press the app icon for "Today's puzzle".

WHAT THE APP ADDS ON iOS
Haptics; Game Center leaderboards, 22 achievements and 7 challenges; widgets; a Control Center control and a Siri / Shortcuts action; an optional daily reminder (a local notification); iCloud sync of progress; the iOS share sheet (an emoji summary of the player's progress with a link to the App Store page; the daily result links to the free website's daily puzzle); on iPhone Duo, layouts for half open like a laptop and like a book, with a left-handed option; light and dark appearance, portrait and landscape. All 53,000 puzzles are bundled, so it plays fully offline.

EXTERNAL SERVICES
None are needed to play. Optional: Game Center (Apple), iCloud key-value storage (Apple) for syncing progress, and GoatCounter, which receives anonymous event counts with no personal data, no identifiers and no cookies. Each puzzle has a link to its page on lichess.org, which opens in Safari.

REGIONS
The app works the same in every region. The game is in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified), following the device's language.

THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
The puzzles come from the Lichess puzzle database, which Lichess released into the public domain (CC0): https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles. The app is not made or endorsed by Lichess and says so in Credits. Chess rules: chess.js (BSD license). Fonts: Fredoka and Nunito (SIL Open Font License). The pieces, icon and artwork are original.
